snippet.title: Nirupma's Kabaragah — Kashmir  #sarinakamini #licious #Meat #Cooking #Kashmirifood
snippet.description:
Kashmiri Pandit 𝐤𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐚𝐡 is a celebration showstopper. As Nirupma explains it, the cut of the mutton required to make kabargah is everything. It has to be front rib — “that’s where the meat is” — and it has to have a ratio of fat and meat: that fat, along with the long, slow cook in milk, is what gives the particular rich and tender texture for which this dish is known. Nirupma has been making it for more than 50 years.

𝐋𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐠𝐨𝐚𝐭 𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐬 — 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐮𝐭𝐭𝐨𝐧 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭 𝐫𝐢𝐛 — ensured the 2-hour cook was worth the wait.

Though she grew up in Delhi, Nirupma says her Kashmiri Pandit mother and father were incredibly particular about keeping a Kashmiri kitchen. To this day, Nirupma’s house is first port of call for friends craving a taste of Kashmir. 

Nirupma’s top kabargah tip: save the masala-heavy milk from the first cook of the mutton ribs to add to the curd and besan batter in which the ribs are dipped before being fried. If you would like the recipe for her family garam masala, DM me.

𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒕𝒐 𝑳𝒊𝒄𝒊𝒐𝒖𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒉𝒆𝒍𝒑𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒖𝒑𝒑𝒐𝒓𝒕 𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒊𝒏𝒖𝒆𝒅 𝒘𝒐𝒓𝒌 𝒓𝒆𝒄𝒐𝒓𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒚, 𝒘𝒊𝒔𝒅𝒐𝒎, 𝒄𝒖𝒍𝒕𝒖𝒓𝒂𝒍 𝒔𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒚 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒓𝒂𝒐𝒓𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒓𝒚 𝒓𝒆𝒄𝒊𝒑𝒆𝒔 𝒇𝒓𝒐𝒎 𝑰𝒏𝒅𝒊𝒂’𝒔 𝒐𝒓𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒓𝒚 𝒌𝒊𝒕𝒄𝒉𝒆𝒏𝒔. 

NIRUPMA’S KABARGAH

FIRST COOK
900gm Licious goat chops
1 litre full fat milk
3 tej patta
8 laung
10 black peppercorns
5 badi elaichi
6 elaichi
1-inch dalchini
1 javitrti
1/4 jaiphal, crushed
1 tsp saunth
2 tsp saunf
3 tsp salt, or to taste

On high heat in a large patila, cook down mutton ribs with milk and the tej patta. But the other khada masala in a potli and add to the pot. Stir occasionally, scraping the milk off the patila’s sides. Add saunf and saunth after 45 minutes. It’s ready when the milk has almost cooked down completely and the ribs are tender but not falling off the bone.

This takes at least 1 hour. Remove the ribs. Reserve the leftover thickened masala milk.

SECOND COOK
Thickened masala milk
3 large spoons dahi
1.5 large spoons besan
.5 tsp Nirupma’s garam masala
1 tsp salt
1.5 tsp saunf
1 tsp saunth

Mix until pancake-like batter. Add masalas.

Dip the ribs in the masala batter and deep fry in vegetable oil. Serve hot.

𝘼𝙡𝙡 𝙝𝙤𝙢𝙚 𝙘𝙤𝙤𝙠𝙨 𝙬𝙚𝙧𝙚 𝙤𝙛𝙛𝙚𝙧𝙚𝙙 𝙥𝙖𝙮𝙢𝙚𝙣𝙩 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙞𝙧 𝙩𝙞𝙢𝙚 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙠𝙣𝙤𝙬𝙡𝙚𝙙𝙜𝙚.

snippet.title: 실수 고백한 도란에게 오너 "형이?" "알아." #T1 #도란 #오너
snippet.description:
2025 롤드컵(월즈) T1 vs 100T, 40분이 넘는 혈전 끝에 이긴 직후의 팀보이스입니다.

▶ 경기 끝나자마자 시작된 복기
정글러 오너가 "현준이 형" 하고 부르더니, 아까 그 장면에서 다이브를 어떻게 했어야 하는지 묻습니다.
- 현준 = 도란의 본명(최현준)
- 다이브 = 적 포탑(타워) 밑까지 쫓아 들어가 공격하는 것
도란은 "근데 다시 하면 깔끔하게 되긴 해"라고 하고,
오너가 "어떻게 해야 돼?"라고 다시 묻자 "끝나고 말해줄게"라며 설명을 미룹니다.

▶ 도란의 고백, 오너의 대답
도란: "스킬 실수 하나 한 거 있었는데"
오너: "형이?"
도란: "어"
오너: "알아."
도란: "어?"
놀란 척하다가 이미 알고 있었다고 받아치는 오너. 이긴 경기라 진짜 탓하는 게 아니라, 친한 팀원끼리 하는 장난입니다.

※ 대사는 T1 공식 영상의 한국어 자막 기준이며, 마지막 도란의 "어?"는 영상 음성으로 확인했습니다.
출처: T1 공식 '2025 T1scord Ep.16 - VS 100T'
